def VTask.binaryRec : {motive : ℕ → Sort u} → (zero : motive 0) → (bit : (b : Bool) → (n : ℕ) → motive n → motive (Nat.bit b n)) → (n : ℕ) → motive n :=
  fun {motive} zero bit n =>
    have h : ∀ (n : ℕ), motive n := by
      intro n
      induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h n ih =>
        cases n with
        | zero => exact zero
        | succ n =>
          have h₁ : n.succ = Nat.bit (n.succ.testBit 0) (n.succ >>> 1) := by
            have h₂ : n.succ.testBit 0 = if n.succ % 2 = 1 then true else false := by
              simp [Nat.testBit, Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one]
              <;> split_ifs <;> simp_all [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
              <;> omega
            rw [h₂]
            have h₃ : n.succ % 2 = 1 ∨ n.succ % 2 = 0 := by omega
            cases h₃ with
            | inl h₃ =>
              have h₄ : n.succ.testBit 0 = true := by simp [h₂, h₃]
              simp [h₄, Nat.bit, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_assoc]
              <;>
              (try omega) <;>
              (try {
                have h₅ : n.succ % 2 = 1 := by omega
                have h₆ : (n.succ >>> 1) = (n.succ / 2) := by
                  simp [Nat.shiftr_eq_div_pow]
                  <;>
                  (try omega)
                rw [h₆]
                have h₇ : n.succ = 2 * (n.succ / 2) + 1 := by
                  have h₈ := Nat.div_add_mod (n.succ) 2
                  have h₉ : n.succ % 2 = 1 := by omega
                  omega
                omega
              })
            | inr h₃ =>
              have h₄ : n.succ.testBit 0 = false := by simp [h₂, h₃]
              simp [h₄, Nat.bit, Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_assoc]
              <;>
              (try omega) <;>
              (try {
                have h₅ : n.succ % 2 = 0 := by omega
                have h₆ : (n.succ >>> 1) = (n.succ / 2) := by
                  simp [Nat.shiftr_eq_div_pow]
                  <;>
                  (try omega)
                rw [h₆]
                have h₇ : n.succ = 2 * (n.succ / 2) := by
                  have h₈ := Nat.div_add_mod (n.succ) 2
                  have h₉ : n.succ % 2 = 0 := by omega
                  omega
                omega
              })
          rw [h₁]
          have h₂ : (n.succ >>> 1) < n.succ := by
            have h₃ : n.succ >>> 1 < n.succ := by
              apply Nat.div_lt_self
              <;> omega
            exact h₃
          have h₃ : motive (n.succ >>> 1) := ih (n.succ >>> 1) h₂
          have h₄ : n.succ.testBit 0 = if n.succ % 2 = 1 then true else false := by
            simp [Nat.testBit, Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one]
            <;> split_ifs <;> simp_all [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
            <;> omega
          simp_all [h₄, bit]
          <;>
          (try {
            split_ifs at * <;>
            simp_all [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
            <;>
            (try omega)
          })
          <;>
          (try {
            simp_all [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
            <;>
            (try omega)
          })
    exact h n
